consent.title: Connect an AI client

destination.sectionLabel: Where your access will be sent

headline.local: A program on your own computer
headline.remote: This sends your Aura Cloud access to a server on the internet.

hint.local: That's what you'd expect if you just ran a command in your terminal.
hint.remote: Only continue if you recognise this address. If you started this from your terminal, it should point at your own computer — not a website.

client.unnamed: an app that didn't give a name
client.noticeUnverified: Requested by {{clientName}} — an app can call itself anything. Check the address, not the name.

access.sectionLabel: What it will be able to do
access.readStatus: See the health and permission status of every AWS resource you monitor
access.manageWatchlist: Add, change, and remove resources on your watchlist
access.actAsYou: Do all of this as you — it sees exactly what you see, nothing more

awsNotLinked.title: You haven't linked an AWS identity yet
awsNotLinked.body: You can still connect, but the AI's tools will return an error until you link one. You can do that any time from Settings.

consent.acknowledge: I understand this sends my Aura Cloud access to {{host}}
consent.footerNote: You can disconnect this at any time from Settings.

invalid.title: This request doesn't look right
invalid.body: This link is incomplete, expired, or points somewhere the app didn't register. Nothing was connected — run the connect command again.

consent.loadError: Couldn't load the details of this request.

onboard.title: Connect your AWS account
onboard.subtitle: Aura needs read-only access to your AWS account to start monitoring your infrastructure.
onboard.step1Description: Click the button below to open AWS CloudFormation. It will deploy a read-only IAM role in your account and generate the credentials you need.
onboard.step2Description: Once the stack is deployed, copy the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key from the CloudFormation outputs and paste them below.
onboard.successDescription: Your AWS account is now linked. Taking you to your dashboard...

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile, your AI connections, and your AWS setup.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update your personal and company information.

connectAi.title: Connect your AI
connectAi.description: Give Claude Code access to your Aura Cloud data, so you can ask it whether a failure is your code or your cloud.

awsNotLinked.body: Link your AWS identity first. You can connect without it, but every tool your AI calls will come back with a permission error until you do.

command.label: Run this in your terminal
command.hint: Your browser will open and ask you to approve the connection. Approve it once and you're done.
command.safeToShare: There's no password or key in this command. It's safe to put in a README or send to a teammate.

clients.title: Connected clients
clients.empty: Nothing is connected yet. Run the command above and approve the request in your browser — whatever you connect appears here, and you can cut it off from this list at any time.
clients.unnamed: This app didn't give itself a name.
clients.disconnectSuccess: Disconnected {{origin}}. It can't come back without your approval.
clients.nameCaveat: App names are chosen by the apps themselves and we don't check them — judge a connection by its address.

confirmDisconnect.title: Disconnect this AI client?
confirmDisconnect.body: This is the client at {{origin}}, connected {{connected}}. It loses access straight away and can't reconnect without your approval — though a request it already started may keep working for up to an hour. Reconnecting later is the same command you ran the first time.

invite.title: Team Invite
invite.description: Share the code and sign-up link with your team so they can join your workspace.
invite.hint: Employees need both the sign-up link and the invite code to create their account.

aws.title: AWS Credentials
aws.description: Rotate your AWS access keys. Enter new credentials and save to update.

team.title: Teams
team.subtitle: Manage employees, teams, and watchlist presets for {{companyName}}.

employees.aloneHint: You're the only one here so far — share the invite code above to bring your team in.
employees.lastManagerTooltip: {{name}} is the only manager — promote someone else first.
employees.selfRemoveTooltip: You can't remove your own account.
employees.roleChangeLastManagerError: Can't change role — {{name}} is the only manager. Promote someone else first.
employees.teamAssignError: Couldn't update team assignment. Try again.
employees.removeLastManagerError: Can't remove the only manager in the company. Promote someone else first.

teams.emptyDescription: Group your employees into teams to manage rosters and starting watchlists together.

presets.removedEmployeeTooltip: This employee's account was removed. Delete this preset to clean it up.
presets.emptyDescription: Presets give new team members or individuals a starting watchlist automatically — set one up for a team or a person.
presets.noEligibleTeams: Every team already has a preset. Edit one from the list instead.
presets.noEligibleIndividuals: Everyone already has a preset. Edit one from the list instead.
presets.stalenessNotice: Changes here apply going forward only — to people who join {{scope}} or link their AWS identity after you save. It won't update anyone who already has a watchlist.

aiAccess.summaryExternal_one: {{count}} of them sends your data to a server outside your company.
aiAccess.summaryExternal_other: {{count}} of them send your data to a server outside your company.
aiAccess.nameCaveat: App names are chosen by the app itself — we don't check them. Judge a connection by the address it connects from.
aiAccess.disconnectError: Couldn't disconnect {{name}}'s connection from {{origin}}. Try again.
aiAccess.loadError: Couldn't load your company's AI connections. {{error}}
aiAccess.emptyDescription: Nobody in your company has connected an AI client to Aura Cloud. When someone does, their connection appears here and you can cut it off from this list.

confirmDialog.removeEmployeeBody: They'll lose access to Aura Cloud immediately. This does not affect their existing resource watchlist — only their login is removed, and it can't be undone. {{email}} will be free to sign up again as a new account later.
confirmDialog.deleteTeamBody: Members on this team will be unassigned, not removed — their accounts and existing watchlist entries stay exactly as they are. If this team has a preset, it will be deleted with it. This can't be undone.
confirmDialog.deletePresetBody: This removes the preset for {{scopeLabel}}. It won't change anyone's current watchlist — deleting a preset never takes back resources someone already received. This can't be undone.
confirmDialog.disconnectAiBody: This cuts the connection from {{origin}}, connected {{connected}}. {{firstName}} keeps their account and their watchlist — only this AI client's access ends, and a request it already started may keep working for up to an hour. We won't tell them, so message them if they need to know. They can reconnect it themselves from their own Settings.
